parameters.name: AIDBClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of an existing template operator instance to associate. This parameter takes effect only when ApplicationType is set to polarclaw.

parameters.name: ApplicationType
parameters.description:
The application type. Valid values:

- supabase: Set this value to create a managed Supabase application.
- raycluster: Set this value to create a managed Ray Cluster application.
- polarclaw: Set this value to create a managed PolarClaw application.

parameters.name: Architecture
parameters.description:
The CPU architecture. Valid values:

- x86

parameters.name: AuthProvider
parameters.description: The authentication service provider.

parameters.name: AuthProviderConfig
parameters.description: The configuration of the authentication provider.

parameters.name: AutoAllocatePublicEip
parameters.description: Specifies whether to automatically create and associate with an elastic IP address (EIP).

parameters.name: AutoCreatePolarFs
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable automatic creation of a cold storage Polarlakebase instance. Valid values:
* false (default): Automatic creation is disabled.
* true: Automatic creation is enabled.

parameters.name: AutoRenew
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal.

parameters.name: AutoUseCoupon
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to automatically use coupons. Valid values:
* true (default): Use coupons.
* false: Do not use coupons.

parameters.name: Components
parameters.description: The list of user-defined application subcomponents.

sub_parameters.name: ComponentClass
sub_parameters.description: The specifications of the application subcomponent.

sub_parameters.name: ComponentMaxReplica
sub_parameters.description:
The maximum number of application subcomponents with the same specifications. Default value: the value of ComponentReplica.

- Only raycluster supports this parameter.

sub_parameters.name: ComponentReplica
sub_parameters.description: The number of replicas for the application subcomponent. Default value: 1.

sub_parameters.name: ComponentType
sub_parameters.description:
The type of the application subcomponent.

For supabase, valid values:

- gateway
- backend

For raycluster, valid values:

- head
- worker
- gpuworker

sub_parameters.name: ScaleMax
sub_parameters.description: The maximum number of replicas for component scaling.

sub_parameters.name: ScaleMin
sub_parameters.description: The minimum number of replicas for component scaling.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityGroups
sub_parameters.description: The list of security groups for the application subcomponent. Separate multiple security groups with commas (,).

sub_parameters.name: SecurityIPArrayName
sub_parameters.description: The name of the whitelist IP address group for the application subcomponent. Default value: default.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityIPList
sub_parameters.description: The whitelist IP addresses of the application subcomponent. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,).

sub_parameters.name: SecurityIPType
sub_parameters.description: The type of the whitelist IP addresses for the application subcomponent. Default value: ipv4.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the PolarDB instance on which the application depends.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the application.

parameters.name: DnatEntries
parameters.description: The list of expected DNAT entries for NAT mapping. Specify this parameter together with VpcNatGatewayId. This parameter can be left empty, which indicates that no DNAT entries are created.

sub_parameters.name: FrontPort
sub_parameters.description: The frontend port. This parameter is optional. If not specified, the port is automatically assigned by the control plane to avoid conflicts with ports already in use on the gateway. You can query the assignment result by calling the DescribeApplicationAttribute operation.

sub_parameters.name: PortName
sub_parameters.description: The port name. Valid values: webui, hermesagent, dashboard, and ssh.

parameters.name: DnatIpAddress
parameters.description: The dedicated DNAT NAT IP address that is allocated by the customer (separate from the SNAT IP address) for NAT mapping. The IP address must belong to the specified gateway and be in the available state. The vSwitch of the gateway must belong to the primary CIDR block that is reachable from the office network. Specify this parameter together with VpcNatGatewayId. Prerequisite: An SNAT entry is bound to the vSwitch where the application resides.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description: Default value: `false`. If you set this parameter to `true`, only parameter and resource validation is performed without actually creating resources.

parameters.name: Endpoints
parameters.description: The list of user-defined service endpoints. By default, a VPC endpoint is created.

sub_parameters.name: Description
sub_parameters.description: The description of the service endpoint.

sub_parameters.name: EndpointType
sub_parameters.description: The type of the service endpoint. The value is fixed as Primary.

parameters.name: KnowledgeApplicationSpec
parameters.description: Required for knowledge applications.

parameters.name: MemApplicationSpec
parameters.description: Required for mem0 applications.

parameters.name: ModelApi
parameters.description: The API of the model. This parameter takes effect only when ApplicationType is set to polarclaw.

parameters.name: ModelApiKey
parameters.description: The API key of the model. This parameter takes effect only when ApplicationType is set to polarclaw.

parameters.name: ModelBaseUrl
parameters.description: The URL of the model. This parameter takes effect only when ApplicationType is set to polarclaw.

parameters.name: ModelFrom
parameters.description:
The model source. Valid values:
* bailian: Bailian model.
* custom: Custom model.
* maas: PolarDB model operator.

parameters.name: ModelName
parameters.description: The name of the model. This parameter takes effect only when ApplicationType is set to polarclaw.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description: The list of parameters.

parameters.name: PayType
parameters.description: The billing type.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: The subscription type, such as yearly or monthly.

parameters.name: PolarFSInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the Polarlakebase cold storage or high-performance instance. Default value: empty. If specified, the corresponding storage is mounted to the application.

Currently, only the following applications support this parameter:
- supabase
- raycluster

parameters.name: PromotionCode
parameters.description: The coupon code. If you do not specify this parameter, the default coupon is used.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region. Default value: the region of the instance.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description: The security group ID.

parameters.name: SecurityIPArrayName
parameters.description: The name of the IP whitelist group. Default value: `default`.

parameters.name: SecurityIPList
parameters.description: The IP whitelist. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value `127.0.0.1` is used.

parameters.name: SecurityIPType
parameters.description: The type of the IP address.

parameters.name: SkillTemplateId
parameters.description: The skill template ID.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags.

parameters.name: TargetVersion
parameters.description: The target version.

parameters.name: UsedTime
parameters.description: The subscription duration.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch. Default value: the current vSwitch in the primary zone of the instance.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The VPC ID.

parameters.name: VpcNatGatewayId
parameters.description: The VPC NAT gateway ID for NAT mapping. If specified, NAT mapping is enabled when the instance is created. The NAT gateway must be in the same VPC as the application, use the private network type (intranet), and be in the active state.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone. Default value: the primary zone of the instance.
